channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tim Duncan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tim Duncan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan
item.description:
“It’s what makes this issue so tricky, is that great players — Steph (Curry) and Tim Duncan, Wemby — they’re not only team-changing, but they’re franchise-changing, for even beyond the scope of those guys’ careers. “And so there’s only a handful of players that can do that, that are that valuable. And so teams are all clamoring for them. Sometimes, you don’t know who they are. Steph was the seventh pick. Giannis (Antetokounmpo) was the (15th) pick. So it’s not always the first couple guys, but more often than not, the first pick has an opportunity to be that guy, and that’s what creates this issue.”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan, Feb 10, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Mike Brown on Tim Duncan, Bruce Bowen, OG Anunoby
item.description:
Ian Begley:Mike Brown on OG Anunoby as a defender:

“First-team All Defense. He is more than capable. Really it’s up to him. That’s how good he is on that end of the floor. And I’ve been around those guys; Bruce Bowen, Tim Duncan. I’ve been around a few of them and he’s right there.”

Mike Brown on Tim Duncan, Bruce Bowen, OG Anunoby, Sep 26, 2025. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Tim Duncan, Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Kyrie Irving:

“I'll give you another name, right? That we're not going to allow people to revise history: Hakeem Olajuwon. Salams to my big brother, man. Salams to Hakeem. We're not going to let people pretend like Hakeem was not that. Before there was a Tim Duncan, there was a Hakeem Olajuwon.”

Kyrie Irving on Tim Duncan, Hakeem Olajuwon, Jul 23, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Luke Kornet on Tim Duncan
item.description:
He explained how Duncan played a role behind the jersey number during his introductory press conference on Monday.

“I just hope to be a third of the player that Tim Duncan was,”

Luke Kornet on Tim Duncan, Jul 8, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Kevin Durant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Tim Duncan
item.description:
“Bron at the one, he getting everybody involved. At my two, I'm going, Michael Jordan. At my three, you know who I'm going, Kevin Durant. At my four, I'm coming, Tim Duncan. At my five, I'm coming, Shaquille O'Neal.”

Anthony Edwards on Kevin Durant, Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Tim Duncan, Apr 30, 2025. Source: Fade Away World.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Tim Duncan, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
“My four gonna be Nikola Jokic. My four is Jokic. No disrespect to Tim Duncan... They gonna foul Shaq, so I need somebody who gonna make it so easy for Shaq.”

Anthony Edwards on Tim Duncan, Nikola Jokic, Apr 30, 2025. Source: Fade Away World.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Tim Duncan
item.description:
Asked who the best five-man NBA roster ever would include, Steph said:

“Shaq at the center, Tim Duncan at the power forward, Bron at the three, MJ at the two and me at the one.”

Stephen Curry on Tim Duncan, Nov 15, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Thompson:

“That’s one of the greatest partnerships ever. You can compare it to peanut butter and jelly. They’re one of the greatest duos of all time. No question about it. They won four championships together. You have to win championships together to be compared to Scottie Pippen and Michael Jordan or to Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar or Tim Duncan and Manu Ginobili and Tony Parker. They are definitely in that category or that conversation.”

Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nov 12, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Isiah Thomas, Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan, Larry Bird
item.description:
Jayson Tatum:

“Isiah Thomas didn't win Finals MVP every time. Tim Duncan didn't win Finals MVP every time. Larry Bird. Steph Curry only has one. Kobe won two out of five championships. As a competitor, you want to win and accomplish everything in front of you, absolutely. But I would not be the slightest bit sad, you know, that I didn't win Finals MVP. I would be ecstatic just to win the Finals.”

Jayson Tatum on Isiah Thomas, Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan, Larry Bird, Jun 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tim Duncan, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Another quote from Gregg Popovich on how Victor Wembanyama maintains his poise on the court:

“He will make a step-back three and he won’t act like it is the first step-back three that has ever been made. He is just got more or less the Tim Duncan sort of attitude on things. That’s just who he is.”

Gregg Popovich on Tim Duncan, Victor Wembanyama, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Kobe Bryant, Dirk Nowitzki, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Stephen Curry:

“I am blessed to know and hope that no matter how many years I do play, playing for one franchise and being a part of that group of the legends that have accomplished that feat and won at the highest level and all that. I don’t ever take that for granted either. You got the Kobe [Bryant]’s, the Magic [Johnson]’s, Dirk [Nowitzki], Tim Duncan, those guys helped establish a culture, won, did it with a lot of different roster combinations and different parts in their career.”

Stephen Curry on Kobe Bryant, Dirk Nowitzki, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Aug 29, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Julius Erving on Karl Malone, Tim Duncan, Tiny Archibald
item.description:
Erving struggled to name the last player on his top 10 list.

“I always argue with my son [about] where Tim Duncan belongs, and he's like, 'He belongs ahead of Karl Malone for sure.' I'm taking Karl Malone and that last position... I like Tiny Archibald,”

Julius Erving on Karl Malone, Tim Duncan, Tiny Archibald, Jul 30, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Tim Duncan
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Tracy McGrady on which NBA star needs a documentary next:

“People need to know more about Tim Duncan. He’s a very quiet guy, but he’s a freaking winner.”

Tracy McGrady on Tim Duncan, Jul 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Jeff Green, Tim Duncan, Ishmael Smith, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
DeAndre Jordan told B/R after Game 3.

“When Nikola says something, everybody's awareness is heightened. I always compare him to a guy like Tim Duncan. He's never really super boisterous, but when he does speak, it speaks volumes. Me, Jeff Green, DJ, Ish [Smith], KCP, we'll always give our two cents on things we see during the game, but Nikola saying something elevated the message. I've been on him more about being more vocal, and even in tonight's game, he was extremely vocal and it was good for our team.”

DeAndre Jordan on Jeff Green, Tim Duncan, Ishmael Smith, Nikola Jokic, Jun 8, 2023. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Michael Malone on Tim Duncan, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
“I often make the comparison, I never coached Tim Duncan, but just from coaching against him and hearing stories about those that have been around him, Tim Duncan was a selfless superstar. I look at Nikola Jokic in the same vein. I think Nikola Jokic is truly selfless superstar,where it’s not about him. He’s not looking for people to ‘Look at me, tell me how great I am’. He’s almost embarrassed by the attention. He’s just wants to be one of the guys in the locker room, have fun, work hard and win.”

Michael Malone on Tim Duncan, Nikola Jokic, Jun 1, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Tim Duncan, David Robinson, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Alvin Gentry on Spurs poised to select Victor Wembanyama:

“A generational player, really a player nobody has seen before. Obviously, I got a ton of respect for Pop, and I don’t think (Wemby) could be in a better situation, with Pop having David Robinson and Tim Duncan all of those years.”

Alvin Gentry on Tim Duncan, David Robinson, Victor Wembanyama, May 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Stephen Curry on LeBron James, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Steiny & Guru Show - Stephen Curry on winning a 5th championship would put him past LeBron, Kobe & Duncan’s level:

“The motivation is always just, ‘how much better can I get individually?’It sounds cheesy as hell, but literally, it’s how much better can I get, what is the challenge of this season, and – do we have a belief that we can do it.”

Stephen Curry on LeBron James, Tim Duncan, Apr 1, 2023. Source: omny.fm.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Tim Duncan
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic:

“I want to be the Tim Duncan of the Denver Nuggets, but I need to win a couple championships to be him.”

Nikola Jokic on Tim Duncan, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Avery Johnson on Kevin Durant, Tim Duncan
item.description:
“I don’t know if it was five plays. It’s kind of the same way, the way Pop explains it about the national team this past summer. The plays that they had was that the ball needed to find Kevin Durant. And then everything else is going to be magical. Our plays were, the ball needs to find Tim Duncan. And the rest of us play off of that. … I do remember one play – it’s called ‘four down,’ and that’s the play we ran every time we needed a bucket or when we got in trouble. The ball got to Tim. We mastered ‘four down.'”

Avery Johnson on Kevin Durant, Tim Duncan, Mar 4, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Pat Croce on Tim Duncan, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Justin Grasso:Former #Sixers President Pat Croce on Joel Embiid:

“I would have loved to have had him on our team.... To have Embiid is to like have Tim Duncan back in the day”

Pat Croce on Tim Duncan, Joel Embiid, May 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @JGrasso_.

item.title: LeBron James on Tim Duncan
item.description:
Ryan Ward:LeBron on the Hall of Fame class of Kobe, Duncan and KG:

“Probably one of the best classes that went in at the same time.... Three of the best players to ever play this game.”

LeBron James on Tim Duncan, May 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tim Duncan
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Coach Pop on Duncan's upcoming Hall of Fame speech:

“He really tries to stay away from those kinds of moments. He doesn’t like talking about himself. He’s selfless, he’s pretty much a homebody. I don’t think he’ll be up there for a real long time speaking.”

Gregg Popovich on Tim Duncan, May 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tim Duncan
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Coach Pop on Tim Duncan:

“On a professional level, the most concise way to put it is 'no Duncan, no championships.'On a personal level, I love the guy.”

Gregg Popovich on Tim Duncan, May 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Tim Duncan
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on Malone's Tim Duncan comparison:

“I played against him. I always said he gave me the easiest 20 points ever. He did not feel me, for real. And he was a little bit older. I think that was his last year. I could just imagine him in his prime.”

Nikola Jokic on Tim Duncan, Mar 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Tim Duncan
item.description:
“You should talk to Tim Duncan. Because power forwards and big men are two different categories. Period. But I wish him well. My thing is just stay hungry. Why win one when you can win two, three or four.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Tim Duncan, Dec 16, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Coach Pop on how Tim Duncan, Manu Ginobili, and Tony Parker would have handled the bubble had they been playing at this time:

“They would have done it just like every other player. So far the discipline of the players has been great. They would be fine.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Tim Duncan, Aug 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Corey Benjamin on Tracy McGrady, Jermaine O'Neal, Tim Duncan, Jerry Krause
item.description:
Corey Benjamin:

“I had Arn Tellem as an agent and Arn represented a lot of star players. The Bulls were trying to sign free agents. I hosted Tracy McGrady, Tim Thomas and Jermaine O’Neal when we brought them in. I was there personally for those [meetings] because we were all represented by the same agent (Arn).I remember Jerry Krause told me, ‘If you can get them to sign, I’ll renew your contract.’ I don’t remember Tim Duncan coming in, but I know we wanted Duncan. But we weren’t offering them the money that other teams were offering. I remember Tracy and Jermaine telling me, ‘They’re offering me peanuts.’They weren’t trying to max these guys out; they were trying to give these guys smaller contracts.”

Corey Benjamin on Tracy McGrady, Jermaine O'Neal, Tim Duncan, Jerry Krause, May 18, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Jaren Jackson Jr on Tim Duncan, David Robinson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Jaren Jackson Jr. on how his dad sometimes goes too far down memory lane when talking about David Robinson and Tim Duncan:

“Sometimes he can get off track and start talking about them for 30 minutes when we are watching film on me... Sometimes, you got to tell him to chill out.”

Jaren Jackson Jr on Tim Duncan, David Robinson, Feb 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tim Duncan
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:Gregg Popovich, on Tim Duncan's Hall of Fame candidacy:

“I think a lot will have to do with how he does as an assistant the next few months. If the record turns around, I’d vote for him for sure.”

Gregg Popovich on Tim Duncan, Dec 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Rasheed Wallace, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Garnett told the group in New York.

“I didn't want to fail them. They took a risk on me. When I showed up to set, I was ready. It took me back to, 'OK, it's Rasheed Wallace tonight. It's Tim Duncan tonight' -- watching film. I took those same things coming in here.”

Kevin Garnett on Rasheed Wallace, Tim Duncan, Dec 13, 2019. Source: ESPN.
